channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Kenyan tycoon Chandaria to build family office to lure investors
item.description: Darshan Chandaria is preparing the next evolution of one of Kenya’s longest-standing family businesses.

item.title: A 324-year-old South African wine farm linked to tycoon Tokyo Sexwale goes on auction for $11 million
item.description: Bloemendal Wine Estate, one of South Africa’s most historic vineyards, linked to a former politician and anti-apartheid activist, is hitting the auction block this month, with brokers asking for at least 180 million rand ($11 million).

item.title: Italy turns to African gas after Iran‑linked crisis disrupts five Qatar LNG shipments
item.description: Italy is turning to African gas supplies after Iran‑linked tensions in the Middle East disrupted five LNG shipments from Qatar, raising concerns over the country’s energy security. Italian officials are exploring alternatives including pipeline gas from Libya and Algeria and LNG from Mozambique, as U.S. imports remain uncertain.

item.title: Africa’s top uranium producer Niger revokes gold mining concessions for three firms
item.description: Niger’s military government has cancelled concessions held by three gold mining and processing companies as it intensifies efforts to assert control over the country’s natural resources.

item.title: Zimbabwe charts bold path to clear $23 billion debt and win back investors
item.description: Zimbabwe is taking active steps to settle the $23 billion it owes to multilateral institutions, as negotiations with creditors continue, President Emmerson Mnangagwa said.

item.title: Thousands of South Africans seek evacuation as Middle East war disrupts flights and borders
item.description: More than 6,400 citizens of South Africa have registered their presence across the Middle East as hostilities involving the United States, Israel, and Iran continue to destabilise the region, according to the country’s foreign ministry.

item.title: Top 10 African countries that made the most money from the United States last year
item.description: Last year, African imports from the United States increased, reflecting stronger economic linkages, diversity of demand, and altering global supply chains.

item.title: Gold rush tragedy in Guinea as mine collapses, leaving workers trapped and injured
item.description: At least one person has died, and several others were injured after an artisanal gold mine collapsed near Kintinian, about 25 kilometres from Siguiri in northeastern Guinea, according to local authorities and witnesses.

item.title: 10 African countries with the fewest rocket projectors in 2026
item.description: The security situation in Africa in 2026 is still heavily influenced by outside forces, and as a result, high-end weapons systems like rocket projectors can come in very handy.

item.title: US, UK, China investors on alert as Nigeria rolls out $750 million mini-grid solar initiative
item.description: Nigeria has launched an ambitious $750 million renewable electrification programme aimed at expanding electricity access through solar mini-grids and off-grid power systems, a move officials say could unlock over $1.1 billion in private investment and reshape the country’s energy landscape.
